scientific_integrity: Exact analytic infection probability and polynomial phase factors; Prüfer/AHU exhaustive tree enumeration plus rational Bernstein certificates in the included standalone checker. Self-review only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite sharp classification through seven vertices; homogeneous tree SIR with uniform seed and detection of any infection; no extension to cyclic contacts or arbitrary test schedules. Qualitative parameter effects of decay centrality and epidemic surveillance were known; possible unlocated prior full finite tables remain a residual originality risk.
title: Seven vertices are sharp for transmission-dependent optimal epidemic sentinels on trees
